text:
elaine: Hey team — CatalystFS (prospect) wants a performance benchmark plan for their POC. Goals: sustain ~750 qps, p95 latency <200ms for gen endpoint, cold-start <1s for scaled workers. Need runbook, cost estimate, and any enterprise blockers they’ll ask about. Who can own?

sam: I can lead the run. Quick questions: what model size are they testing? and are we allowed to use dedicated workers or hosted?

mika: They're asking to validate host setup first. Preference is hosted but they want a Dedicated-like SLA for the test (isolation + predictable throughput). Model: they want redwood-4b-std (non-quant) and a fallback to q4cd for burst.

elaine: ok. Primary acceptance criteria: sustained 750 qps for 15min with p95 <200ms, no 5xxs, and cost <= $X/day (TBD). Also need security checklist responses for data residency + KMS.

sam: Preliminary runbook (high level):
```
1) Provisiondedicated pool: 6 x A100-equivalent (autoscale off during test)
2) Warmup: send 5k small requests to populate KV cache (~10m)
3) Smoke: ramp to 100 qps -> 500 qps (5m steps)
4) Sustained: target 750 qps for 15 minutes, capture p50/p90/p95/p99, CPU/GPU util, host mem, queue depth
5) Burst: push to 1k qps for 2m to validate degradation/fallback to q4cd
6) Teardown: graceful drain, collect logs/trace
Key metrics: latency (server + end-to-end), tail-latency, error rate, token/sec, cost tokens consumed
```

sam: config snippets:
```
loadtest --url https://api.redwood-inference.test/v1/generate \
  --model redwood-4b-std \
  --concurrency 400 --ramp 300 --duration 900 \
  --payload-file sample_prompts.json --capture-metrics
```

mika: @sam please include real prompt mixes (short prompt ~30 tokens, long ~600 tokens, 70% short/30% long). Also record model outputs for 500 random samples to check quality regressions when fallback triggers.

raj: On autoscaling / fallback: set queue_max=10k, per-host max_concurrency=40, fallback_policy: on >5% 5xx in 60s switch to q4cd for new requests. Also verify KV cache hit ratio — that’s huge for cost.

katie: Security asks from CatalystFS: 1) Is traffic e2e encrypted? 2) Where are logs stored/how long? 3) KMS integration for customer keys? 4) SOC2 / ISO reports for the Dedicated pool? I can collect answers but need SRE input.

sam: answers: TLS enforced, logs go to retention-30d by default (can extend), Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS via our KMS connector, we have SOC2 report available — will provide redacted copy.

security-team: Also confirm: no customer prompts are persisted in plaintext in shared storage, access controls for debug logs, and option to redact PII on ingest.

elaine: Great. Mika — can you draft cost estimate for: (a) 6 x A100-dedicated for 24h + tokens at our hosted rates, (b) hosted burst scenario with q4 fallback? Need rough $ numbers for customer call tomorrow.

mika: On it. Rough calc: dedicated compute ~ $XXX/hr per node -> ~ $YYYY for full-day. Token cost depends on avg tokens per request (we'll use 300 avg tokens). I’ll post a spreadsheet shortly.

sam: small checklist for the run day:
- prepare sample_prompts.json (attach 1k mixed prompts)
- reserve capacity window 09:00-13:00 PT (no autoscale)
- enable tracing + perf_exporter
- deploy canary of model variant (q4cd) as fallback
- smoke test 30m before main run

elaine: @sam reserve slot and add it to incalendar. @mika send numbers. @katie compile security answers and attach SOC2. I'll lead the customer demo and narrative.

deploy-bot: [deploy] redwood-4b-std canary deployed to pool-catalystfs at 2025-11-09T08:37:12Z :white_check_mark:

raj: One more: capture per-request token breakdown and cost per-token so we can show unit economics (tokens/request, tokens/sec, estimated $/req).

mika: spreadsheet link: https://docs.example.com/spreadsheets/d/CatalystFS-bench-estimate (draft).

elaine: Perfect. Next sync: tomorrow 08:30 PT to align on runbook and handoffs. Thanks everyone :rocket:
